name: Fresco Release Test (schema 9)
description: Purpose-built schema 9 protocol for the Fresco release test. It is conducted on every run and shaped around what schema 9 added: a language chooser, text that shows dynamic values, a bin that keeps the participant until everyone is placed, a stage with nobody to show, the redesigned Family Pedigree with names encrypted by the participant’s passphrase, and two finish stages that end the interview differently. Generated with SyntheticInterview; see apps/fresco/release-test/scripts/schema9-interview-lane.mjs.

prompt.en: Do you agree to take part?

explanationText.en:
# Protect your family’s names

Choose a passphrase. The names of your family are encrypted with it, so nobody but you can read them.
explanationText.es:
# Protege los nombres de tu familia

Elige una frase de contraseña. Los nombres de tu familia se cifran con ella, para que nadie más que tú pueda leerlos.

exitInterviewDescription.en: Your answers so far will be saved and you can continue later.
exitInterviewDescription.es: Tus respuestas hasta ahora se guardarán y podrás continuar más adelante.

stageError.en: There was an error with the interview software, and this task could not be displayed. Some tasks, such as maps, need an internet connection, so check your connection and then try refreshing the page. If the problem persists, please contact the study organizer and send them the debug information, which you can copy with the button below. You may be able to continue your interview by clicking the next button.
stageError.es: Se produjo un error en el programa de la entrevista y no se pudo mostrar esta tarea. Algunas tareas, como los mapas, necesitan conexión a internet, así que comprueba tu conexión y después prueba a actualizar la página. Si el problema persiste, ponte en contacto con la persona que organiza el estudio y envíale la información de diagnóstico, que puedes copiar con el botón de abajo. Es posible que puedas continuar la entrevista pulsando la flecha de avance.

choosePassphraseHelp.en: Some answers on this screen are protected by a passphrase. Keep it safe: you will need it to see or change these answers later, and it cannot be recovered if it is forgotten.
